semantics.cell_maps: Regenerated from the canonical A1 model at verified positive-slack cell representatives; these replace the retired stored center maps.
semantics.edge_maps: Regenerated at verified positive-slack representatives of each exact joint edge domain.
semantics.cell_domain: Exact rational closure geometry in (T, phi_f, phi_s).
semantics.edge_domain: Exact rational joint geometry in current timing/phase and next hold duration; the sampled map depends on current timing/phase only.
semantics.vertices: Exact rational vertices of the closed domains, used only for rigorous affine dwell-range over-approximation.
